settings.media_book_source-tips: Metadata source for books: Douban, Google Books or OpenLibrary.
settings.media_cover_gateway-tips: If direct cover proxying fails, retry through the third-party wsrv.nl image gateway. Cover URLs are sent to that service when enabled. Disabled by default.
settings.media_discogs_token-tips: Personal access token from discogs.com, used for music album metadata.
settings.media_download_cover: Download remote covers to local storage
settings.media_download_cover-tips: Download covers returned by TMDB / Google Books / OpenLibrary into the thumbnail storage path instead of saving the remote URL.
settings.media_emby_enabled-tips: Expose an Emby-compatible API at /@emby for Infuse, VidHub, MoviePilot and similar clients.
settings.media_enabled-tips: Master switch. When off, all media pages, APIs and protocol endpoints return 404, exactly like the media library is not installed.
settings.media_google_books_key-tips: Google Books API key. Optional, but the quota is lower without one. Apply at https://developers.google.com/books/docs/v1/using#APIKey
settings.media_proxy_cover-tips: Proxy external cover images (TMDB, Douban, ...) through the server. Useful when image domains are unreachable; off by default.
settings.media_scrape_concurrency-tips: How many media items are scraped in parallel. Raise it for faster scraping, lower it when you hit API rate limits.
settings.media_scrape_language-tips: Preferred language for scraped metadata. Affects TMDB titles/overviews and the Google Books search language; Douban always returns Chinese.
settings.media_store_thumbnail-tips: Generate and store thumbnails while scraping; when off, the original file path is used as the cover.
settings.media_strm_on_scan-tips: Automatically write .strm files for scraped media items after a scan.
settings.media_strm_overwrite-tips: Overwrite existing .strm files with the same name.
settings.media_strm_path-tips: STRM output directory (a writable VFS path). Only used when "save next to media files" is off.
settings.media_strm_same_dir: Save STRM next to media files
settings.media_strm_same_dir-tips: When on, .strm files are written next to the media file with the same name (only the extension differs); when off, they all go to the directory below.
settings.media_strm_template-tips: STRM content template. Variables: {site_url} site URL, {path} virtual file path, {sign} signature, {name} file name.
settings.media_subsonic_allow_password_auth-tips: Allow Subsonic clients to authenticate with the OpenList password (u+p). This shares the account password with third-party clients. Disabled by default; application keys (apiKey or t+s) are recommended.
settings.media_subsonic_enabled-tips: Expose an OpenSubsonic API at /@rest for Symfonium, Feishin, Amperfy and similar music clients.
settings.media_subsonic_proxy_stream-tips: Subsonic playback returns a 302 redirect by default. Enable this to proxy the stream through the server for clients that do not follow redirects (uses server bandwidth).
settings.media_thumbnail_mode-tips: Base64: stored in database. Runtime: stored under the program data directory (data/imgs). Mounted directory: written to a writable VFS path such as /imgs.
settings.media_thumbnail_path-tips: Only editable in Mounted directory (VFS) mode. Runtime directory mode always uses data/imgs; Base64 mode stores covers in the database.
settings.media_tmdb_api_url-tips: TMDB API host, default api.themoviedb.org. Change it when using a mirror or proxy.
settings.media_tmdb_key-tips: API key from themoviedb.org. Required for movie & TV metadata, posters and backdrops.
settings.transcode_cache_max_gb-tips: Maximum segment cache size. Least recently used entries are removed when the limit is exceeded.
settings.transcode_cache_path-tips: Directory used to cache transcoded segments.
settings.transcode_chunk_duration_sec-tips: Duration of each on-demand transcoding chunk. Larger chunks buffer more media and require fewer FFmpeg process changes. Default: 60 seconds.
settings.transcode_chunk_idle_sec-tips: Stop a chunk's FFmpeg process after this many seconds without access. Default: 60.
settings.transcode_chunk_prefetch-tips: Start the next chunk when the current chunk is more than halfway transcoded, improving continuous playback. Enabled by default.
settings.transcode_enabled-tips: Enable FFmpeg transcoding for media matching the configured rules. Disabled by default.
settings.transcode_ffmpeg_path-tips: Path to FFmpeg. Leave empty to use ffmpeg from PATH.
settings.transcode_ffprobe_path-tips: Path to the FFprobe executable used to inspect source media.
settings.transcode_hwaccel-tips: Choose CPU, automatic detection, NVIDIA NVENC, Intel Quick Sync, Linux VA-API, AMD AMF, or Apple VideoToolbox. The selected accelerator requires compatible hardware and drivers.
settings.transcode_idle_timeout_sec-tips: Stop transcoding after this many seconds without playback requests. Default: 90. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.transcode_job_timeout_min-tips: Maximum duration of a transcoding job before it is marked as failed.
settings.transcode_local_concurrency-tips: Maximum simultaneous jobs on the built-in worker. Applies to local and hybrid modes.
settings.transcode_max_chunk_concurrency-tips: Maximum simultaneous chunks per video job. Higher values use more CPU/GPU resources. Default: 2.
settings.transcode_min_bitrate_mbps-tips: Transcode videos above this bitrate. Set to 0 to remove the bitrate limit.
settings.transcode_min_size_gb-tips: Transcode files above this size; smaller files use direct playback. Set to 0 for any file size.
settings.transcode_output_audio_codec-tips: AAC offers broad compatibility. Copy preserves the source audio stream without re-encoding.
settings.transcode_output_bitrate-tips: Target video bitrate, such as 4000k or 6M. Suggested values: 4000k for 1080p and 2500k for 720p.
settings.transcode_output_codec-tips: Video codec used for transcoding. H.264 offers broad client compatibility.
settings.transcode_output_format-tips: Output container format. HLS offers broad client compatibility.
settings.transcode_output_resolution-tips: Downscale videos above this resolution. Choose Keep source to preserve the original resolution.
settings.transcode_run_mode-tips: Local uses the built-in worker. Remote uses registered workers. Hybrid prefers local workers and sends overflow to remote workers.
settings.transcode_segment_duration-tips: HLS/DASH segment duration. Shorter segments can reduce startup delay but increase requests. Recommended: 4–10 seconds.
settings.transcode_source_codecs-tips: Comma-separated source codecs, such as hevc,av1,vvc,vp9.
settings.transcode_source_extensions-tips: Comma-separated extensions without dots. MP4 is excluded by default for direct playback.
settings.transcode_worker_secret-tips: Shared secret for remote worker registration. Leave empty to disable registration.

media_lib.base_desc: Master switch, Emby / OpenSubsonic endpoints and app keys
media_lib.protocol_disabled: Not enabled (turn on {{key}} in the settings above)
media_lib.protocol_auth_tip: If the Emby/Subsonic client has no key field, use your OpenList username and put the app key in the password field. For Subsonic clients that append /rest automatically, set the address to /@rest.
media_lib.app_keys_desc: Used for Subsonic token auth, Emby api_key and headless clients such as MoviePilot. If a client has no key field, enter your OpenList username and put the key in the password field
media_lib.key_once: This key is shown only once, copy it now:
media_lib.scrape_desc: Metadata sources, thumbnail storage and scrape concurrency
media_lib.strm_desc: Generate .strm files during scan, or run a bulk generation here
media_lib.strm_output_same_dir: Next to the media files (same name, .strm extension)
media_lib.strm_output_missing: Not configured (save the STRM directory above first)
media_lib.thumb_scope: Applies to {{type}} only; falls back to the global media settings when unset.
media_lib.thumb_store_tips: Generate thumbnails while scraping; when off, the original image path is used as the cover
media_lib.mode_base64_tips: Thumbnails are stored in the database as Base64. No extra file storage is needed, but the database grows.
media_lib.mode_runtime_tips: Thumbnails are stored under the program data directory, data/imgs by default. No mounted storage is required.
media_lib.mode_local_tips: Thumbnails are written to a VFS path under a mounted storage, which must be writable (e.g. /imgs).
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_runtime: Path relative to the program data directory, imgs by default (data/imgs)
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_local: VFS path relative to the mount root /, e.g. /imgs or /.thumbnail
media_lib.thumb_rerun: Changes take effect after re-scraping (clear scraped data in Media Manage, then run scraping again).
media_lib.thumb_config_missing: Media type config not loaded, please refresh and try again
media_lib.thumb_saved: Thumbnail settings saved, effective after re-scraping
